flaws.description: Changed the y-axis label from 'Average Density Change' to an unrelated quantity, 'Median Household Income (USD)'.

Replaced the true chart title 'Average Population Density Change by Metro Area and Zone (2010-2020)' with an unrelated, factually wrong title 'Annual Rainfall Levels by Region and Season (2010-2020)'.

Passed an explicit legend label list to plt.legend() with 'Urban Core' and 'Inner Suburb' swapped, so the legend now attributes the teal-green bars to 'Inner Suburb' and the deep-purple bars to 'Urban Core' even though the drawing order (and colors) are unchanged.
